map.公共区每 100㎡ 每日约 1 个垃圾袋、按月 30 天计，5000㎡ 约 15: Public area about 1 bag per 100 m2 per day, over 30 days 5000 m2 is about 1500/month; times a foot-traffic factor (e.g. 1.3) gives about 1950; stock accordingly with a 10% safety buffer.
map.人流量大时怎么调整？: How to adjust for high foot traffic?
map.在基准量上乘人流量系数，地铁口、商场中庭等高频区可取 1.3~1.5，低频办公区: Multiply the baseline by a foot-traffic factor; high-frequency zones like subway entrances and mall atria take 1.3-1.5, low-frequency offices take 1.0-1.1.
map.估算含不含设备损耗？: Does the estimate include equipment wear?
map.默认只算易耗品类（垃圾袋、清洁剂、拖布、手套等），不含尘推、洗地机等设备折旧，设: By default only consumables (trash bags, cleaners, mops, gloves, etc.) are counted, not dust pushers or scrubbers' depreciation; equipment goes in a separate asset ledger.
map.实行定量领用与以旧换新、按需配浓度（避免清洁剂过量）、 reusable 拖布替: Adopt measured issuance and trade-in, mix concentration on demand (avoid excess cleaner), and replace disposable mops with reusable ones to significantly cut consumption.
